newsitem.title: JAPAN: Aisin Seiki, GM form venture to sell transmissions.
newsitem.headline: Aisin Seiki, GM form venture to sell transmissions.

text.p: Car parts maker Aisin Seiki Co Ltd said on Tuesday that it had formed a joint venture in Japan with General Motors Corp to sell automatic transmissions for buses and trucks.
Aisin GM Allison Co Ltd, capitalised at 90 million yen, is 60 percent owned by GM and 40 percent by Aisin, Aisin said in a statement.
Aisin is 22.4 percent owned by Toyota Motor Corp.
The venture expects sales of two billion yen in 1997, rising to 10 billion yen in 2005, Aisin said.
The joint venture will sell the transmissions in Asia and Oceania, Aisin said.
